summary: Pet Idle Game feature testing completed. All backend APIs working correctly after fixing type annotation bug in idle game endpoints. Frontend game mechanics (buying, merging, CPS, upgrades, persistence) all functioning properly.

fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: Idle game endpoints had incorrect type annotations - `current_user: dict` should be `current_user: User`, and `current_user["user_id"]` should be `current_user.id`
fixed_by_testing_agent.fix_applied: Updated type hints from dict to User and changed attribute access from dict key to object property

passed_tests: Game page loads at /idle-game with correct data-testid attributes
Initial state shows 50 coins, 0/s CPS, empty 4x5 grid
Buy button shows 'Buy Bunny' with cost (10 coins initial)
Buying animal places Bunny (T1) on first empty slot and deducts coins
Buy cost increases with each purchase (10 -> 11 -> 12)
Buy button disabled when coins insufficient (tested)
Selecting a slot highlights it with lime/green border glow
Merging two same-tier animals creates next tier (2x Bunny T1 -> Kitty T2)
CPS updates correctly (T1 = 1/s, T2 = 2/s)
Coins increase over time based on CPS (verified 29 -> 36 over 3s with 2/s CPS)
Character images display correctly for Bunny (T1) and Kitty (T2) with imageUrl
Tier badge shows correctly (T1, T2) in top-right of slot
Best Tier tracking works (header shows 'Best: Tier X')
Upgrades panel expands when clicked showing CPS Boost and Prestige options
CPS Boost upgrade shows Lv.1 with +25% bonus, cost 500 coins
Prestige button shows current multiplier (1.0x) and potential bonus
Bottom navigation shows Pet Idle with paw icon in center position (elevated)
Navigation between Pet Idle and other pages works correctly
localStorage persistence working - game state saves automatically
Backend GET /api/idle-game/state requires auth (returns 401 without token)
Backend GET /api/idle-game/state returns state for logged-in user
Backend POST /api/idle-game/save requires auth (returns 401 without token)
Backend POST /api/idle-game/save saves game state successfully
Backend state persistence verified (save -> get returns same data)
Backend validates request body (returns 422 for missing 'state' key)
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fixed: idle game endpoints had incorrect type annotations causing 'dict' object subscript errors
Code quality: Animal data has imageUrl for tiers 1-12, higher tiers use emoji fallback as designed
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Fixed type annotations in idle game endpoints
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pet Idle game feature is fully functional. Backend API fix applied (type annotation bug). Game mechanics working: buying animals (places T1 Bunny), merging same-tier animals (creates next tier), CPS calculation, coin accumulation over time, upgrades panel with CPS Boost and Prestige, localStorage persistence for guests, backend save/load for logged-in users. Auto-save occurs every 30 seconds. Grid is 4x5 (20 slots). First 12 animal tiers have custom images, higher tiers use emoji fallback.

mocked_apis.note: All idle game APIs are real - no mocking
